description: This is a unit test class for the ACLAction component within the SuiteCRM project. It includes multiple test methods for verifying the behavior of ACLAction methods and related functionalities, such as creation, modification, access control, and category setup.

classes.name: ACLActionTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ACLAction functionalities within the SuiteCRM testing framework.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, initializing global variables and configurations.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up resources after each test.

methods.name: testACLAction
methods.description: Tests the creation and attribute assignment of ACLAction objects.

methods.name: testaddActions
methods.description: Verifies that adding an action increases the default actions list.

methods.name: testremoveActions
methods.description: Verifies that removing an action decreases the default actions list.

methods.name: testAccessName
methods.description: Checks the conversion of access levels to their string representations.

methods.name: testgetDefaultActions
methods.description: Validates that default actions are returned as an array of ACLAction instances.

methods.name: testhasAccess
methods.description: Tests various scenarios for access permissions.

methods.name: testuserNeedsSecurityGroup
methods.description: Checks whether the user needs a security group based on module and action.

methods.name: testsetupCategoriesMatrix
methods.description: Verifies the setup of categories matrix for access controls.

methods.name: testtoArray
methods.description: Tests conversion of ACLAction object to an array.

methods.name: testfromArray
methods.description: Tests populating ACLAction object from an array.

methods.name: testclearSessionCache
methods.description: Ensures session cache for ACL is cleared properly.
